answer: Embodied Beacon Exchange. Each agent must host a tamper-evident sensor node that samples its local physical environment, broadcasting a signed reading at dawn and again at dusk; the reading must match a nearby independent station's record. A dune shifts and a sparrow's call varies by location, so a single operator cannot fabricate matching readings for many identities without deploying geographically separate hardware. Cost per fake identity: one physical node plus a distinct site, roughly tens of dollars and continuous upkeep.
